features.name: North Shore Water Steps
features.description: North Shore Water Steps and adjacent Canal Square form the park's signature sandstone water landscape, connecting North Shore Drive to the Esplanade and riverfront.

features.name: Tribute to Children
features.description: Tribute to Children is the Fred Rogers memorial built around a reused Manchester Bridge pier, with Robert Berks' seated bronze figure facing the rivers and Downtown skyline.

features.name: Korean War Veterans Memorial
features.description: The Korean War Veterans Memorial is the dark, fin-like memorial west of PNC Park near Mazeroski Way, rededicated at its present North Shore Riverfront Park site in 2001.
